ayahs.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.e2: I do swear by the Day of Judgment

ayahs.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection]
ayahs.e2: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul
ayahs.tr: Wa laaa uqsimu bin nafsil lawwaamah

ayahs.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones
ayahs.e2: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones

ayahs.ar: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّيَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayahs.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips
ayahs.e2: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips

ayahs.en: But man desires to continue in sin
ayahs.e2: Still people want to deny what is yet to come

ayahs.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.e2: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

ayahs.en: So when vision is dazzled
ayahs.e2: But when the sight is stunned

ayahs.en: And the moon darkens
ayahs.e2: and the moon is dimmed

ayahs.en: And the sun and the moon are joined
ayahs.e2: and the sun and the moon are brought together

ayahs.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape
ayahs.e2: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”
ayahs.tr: Yaqoolul insaanu yaw ma 'izin aynal mafarr

ayahs.en: No! There is no refuge
ayahs.e2: But no! There will be no refuge

ayahs.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence
ayahs.e2: On that Day all will end up before your Lord

ayahs.ar: يُنَبَّؤُاْ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back
ayahs.e2: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind
ayahs.tr: Yunabba 'ul insaanu yawma 'izim bimaa qaddama wa akhkhar

ayahs.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness
ayahs.e2: In fact, people will testify against their own souls

ayahs.en: Even if he presents his excuses
ayahs.e2: despite the excuses they come up with

ayahs.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكۡ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعۡجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayahs.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an
ayahs.e2: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran
ayahs.tr: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaa naka lita'jala bih

ayahs.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation
ayahs.e2: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it

ayahs.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation
ayahs.e2: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺
ayahs.tr: Fa izaa qaraanaahu fattabi' qur aanah

ayahs.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you]
ayahs.e2: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺

ayahs.en: No! But you love the immediate
ayahs.e2: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world

ayahs.en: And leave the Hereafter
ayahs.e2: and neglect the Hereafter

ayahs.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant
ayahs.e2: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

ayahs.en: Looking at their Lord
ayahs.e2: looking at their Lord

ayahs.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted
ayahs.e2: And ˹other˺ faces will be gloomy

ayahs.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking
ayahs.e2: anticipating something devastating to befall them

ayahs.en: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
ayahs.e2: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺

ayahs.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]
ayahs.e2: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”

ayahs.en: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
ayahs.e2: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart

ayahs.en: And the leg is wound about the leg
ayahs.e2: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺

ayahs.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession
ayahs.e2: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺

ayahs.en: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed
ayahs.e2: This denier neither believed nor prayed

ayahs.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away
ayahs.e2: but persisted in denial and turned away

ayahs.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride]
ayahs.e2: then went to their own people, walking boastfully

ayahs.en: Woe to you, and woe
ayahs.e2: Woe to you, and more woe

ayahs.en: Then woe to you, and woe
ayahs.e2: Again, woe to you, and even more woe

ayahs.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected
ayahs.e2: Do people think they will be left without purpose

ayahs.ar: أَلَمۡ يَكُ نُطۡفَةࣰ مِّن مَّنِيࣲّ يُمۡنَىٰ
ayahs.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted
ayahs.e2: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted
ayahs.tr: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa

ayahs.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
ayahs.e2: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form

ayahs.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female
ayahs.e2: producing from it both sexes, male and female
ayahs.tr: Faja'ala minhuz zawjayniz zakara wal unsaa

ayahs.ar: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ
ayahs.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead
ayahs.e2: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life
ayahs.tr: Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa
